POSIX CPU timer exec() UAF introduced in Linux 5.7. Fixed: 6.6 ≥ 6.6.158, 6.12 ≥ 6.12.112, 6.18 ≥ 6.18.54, 7.2 ≥ 7.2.8, 7.3 and later; 5.10 / 5.15 / 6.1 branches unpatched, still affected.

Your kernel is not in the above affected range (below 5.7, or already a patched version). Execution will continue (not blocked) but exploit will likely fail. Vendors may have backported fixes without changing version number; this judgment is for reference only. Assess risk yourself.
